chart.programText: A = data('lambda.function.initialization', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['aws_function_name']).sum(over='1d').publish(label='A')

chart.name: Errors by version
chart.programText: A = data("lambda.function.shutdown", filter=(not filter("aws_function_shutdown_cause", "spindown")) and (not filter("aws_function_shutdown_cause", "timeout")), rollup="sum", extrapolation="zero").sum(by=["aws_function_name", "aws_function_version", "aws_function_shutdown_cause"]).sum(over="1d").publish(label="A")

chart.name: Initialization latency
chart.programText:
A = data('lambda.function.initialization.latency', rollup='min', extrapolation='zero').above(0).min().min(over='1d').publish(label='A')
B = data('lambda.function.initialization.latency', rollup='max').max().max(over='1d').publish(label='B')
C = data('lambda.function.initialization.latency').mean().mean(over='1d').publish(label='C')

chart.name: Lambda logs
chart.programText: logs(filter=field('source') == '*:/aws/lambda/*:*').publish()

Lambda logs
